note: Allen Parish (FIPS 22003) has no queryable zoning district service found. The parish GIS mapping site (actdatascout.com, also gismaps.org) reportedly shows zoning boundaries, but only as a web viewer with no public ArcGIS REST or download, and it returned HTTP 403 to automated reads. The police jury's KALB-reported layer list omits zoning. The cities of Oakdale, Oberlin and Kinder have no public zoning GIS layer found; Oakdale's site lists ordinances only.
